claim: after poke(@mutable h) with no later store, h.r has exactly two origins: Written by CallSite::Operation(poke) argument 0 at path Holder::r, then formal first with no edge; the reader rejects a dropped, duplicated, reordered or redirected writer and a product whose lending operand is made shared or lends other storage

label: psi-output/parked-descriptor-outliving-writable-loan-originals
entry: A parked descriptor can reach its crossing
claim: each archived program of the former gap lowers: a loan k=@mutable h formed after the first crossing is no origin there and at the second crossing names the borrow then second; a store h.r=second after let m=@mutable h;keep(m), after let m=keep(@mutable h) returning @mutable Holder, and after a call with a second writable operand lent or moved in names only second; the Psi-only reader replays the same rows

label: psi-output/parked-descriptor-named-writable-loan
entry: A parked descriptor can reach its crossing
claim: let m=@mutable h;keep(m) with no later store gives h.r exactly two origins: Written by the BorrowPlace of h at path Holder::r, then formal first; the reader rejects the writer dropped and a product whose BorrowPlace is made shared

label: psi-output/parked-descriptor-store-after-named-loan
entry: A parked descriptor can reach its crossing
claim: let m=@mutable h;keep(m);h.r=second names formal second as the one origin; the borrow before the store is no origin

label: psi-output/policy-template-toolchain-callee
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: the unselected Rule::plan is one closed body with no static argument and one region, which fills the schema formal and the result; it returns the result of its constructor call, whose target is the body carried under the toolchain's language\core\access\new_plan and which applies the plan's region to the constructor's binder

label: psi-output/policy-template-constructor-operands
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: the constructor call's operands are a shared borrow of the whole schema formal and a move of the place the preceding operation established as the toolchain's Issuance::Unrestricted case with no fields, typed by the toolchain's Issuance row

label: psi-output/policy-template-issuance-twins
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: without a domain selecting Rule, the dotdot, helper and local_annot twins lower Rule::plan plus exactly their called helper as closed bodies; a Psi-only reader follows the issuance to new_plan, which is lent the schema and moved the issuance: Only with an empty routes sequence formed at the omission's site for dotdot, and Unrestricted for the helper and the let local

label: psi-output/policy-template-helper-owners
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: with two modules declaring open, both helpers are closed bodies under their own modules; the plan's calls name high\open or low\open by the imported module, then the toolchain constructor, and the issuance is Unrestricted only through high\open

label: psi-output/policy-template-descriptor-array
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: reflect\callable(pick) is a descriptor step naming the package's machine pick with no arguments, typed CallableInfo<'t>, and the array step lands it as the only element of [CallableInfo<'t>; 1]

label: psi-output/policy-template-route-lists
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: Only{routes:[]} lowers in the closed plan as one EstablishStructuralArray with no elements, typed as a sequence of the toolchain's CallableInfo, which the Issuance::Only establishment copies into routes; a Psi-only reader finds no routes in the issuance moved to new_plan

label: psi-output/policy-template-construct-establishment
entry: An unselected access policy can publish a closed plan body
claim: the closed mk establishes Small from its scalar formal at the site of the EstablishData obligation, and its result schema carries the one requires clause; the twin without the clause has neither

label: psi-output/nominal-view-count
entry: An exclusive nominal-element view retains
claim: The returned u64 measures the named nominal-element descriptor. Its Psi type preserves shared or mutable access and the declared element, including when a different record view is the first formal.

label: psi-output/qualified-float-contract
entry: An IEEE comparison in a requirement
claim: The Small formal keeps its binary32 domain. The unqualified control has none. Both publish Formal(0), the landed bits of one and binary32 LessThan.

label: psi-output/qualified-float-contract-consumer
entry: An IEEE comparison in a requirement
claim: The Psi reader decides the Small clause at half, one, NaN and negative zero and follows the second formal when a same-carrier parameter precedes it.

label: psi-output/float-domain-formal
entry: An IEEE comparison in a requirement
claim: The declared and body formal refer to binary32 and the packaged Unit domain. The control declares Unit and carries no tag.

label: psi-output/unproved-final-selector-fills
entry: An exclusive nominal-element view retains
claim: The final store publishes the actual captured move and store selectors. The checker must justify that this fill repairs the outstanding window before return.

label: psi-output/separate-view-extraction-obligations
entry: An exclusive nominal-element view retains
claim: The Psi-only reader independently recovers both extraction and fill pairs. The simultaneous open windows still require disjointness.

label: psi-output/transitive-selector-final-fill
entry: An exclusive nominal-element view retains
claim: The final fill retains its own selector and the extraction retains its selector. Only the positive program carries both premises connecting them; their proof belongs to the checker.

label: psi-output/runtime-mutable-loan-formal
entry: A runtime callable with a shared reference to a scalar
claim: The callable has a mutable reference to u8 in the original case and a shared reference in the control, with the same u8 result.

label: psi-output/runtime-mutable-reborrows
entry: A runtime callable with a shared reference to a scalar
claim: The reader resolves two ordered mutable reborrows of the same parameter and rejects a changed access.

label: psi-output/runtime-shared-record-formal
entry: A runtime callable with a shared reference to a scalar
claim: The descriptor references the exact Counter declaration while the control references u64.

label: psi-output/runtime-record-reborrow
entry: A runtime callable with a shared reference to a scalar
claim: The Psi reader resolves the reborrow to Counter on the selected formal even beside another record with the same layout.

label: psi-output/runtime-borrowed-result
entry: A runtime callable with a shared reference to a scalar
claim: The Get interface publishes a shared reference result with lifetime input zero; the scalar-result control carries no such relation.

label: psi-output/runtime-borrowed-call-lifetime
entry: A runtime callable with a shared reference to a scalar
claim: The reader maps the result lifetime to the input of the indirect call. Its return carries the fresh result descriptor. Redirecting the lifetime to a scalar input fails.

label: psi-output/applied-record-formal
entry: A closed application used only as a machine formal
claim: The reader follows the formal lane and its place to the exact Buffer schema and selected u32 or u16 field. The plain control keeps its scalar formal.

label: psi-output/declared-trait-parent
entry: A declared trait parent names the exact applied interface
claim: C names P, the parentless twin has no parent, and the Q<u8> twin resolves its inherited id requirement to Q with the original type argument.

label: psi-output/open-record-value-binder
entry: An open template's static value binder keeps its declared carrier
claim: Same-layout P and Q remain distinguishable by their nominal binder identities. Both templates return the same formal.

label: psi-output/template-integer-literal
entry: An open callback wrapper publishes its binder contract
claim: The sum consumes the selected callback result and the integer literal one with its landed u64 carrier and ResultFitsCarrier debt.

label: psi-output/template-integer-literal-consumer
entry: An open callback wrapper publishes its binder contract
claim: The consumer evaluates five plus one to six and reports the result-fit question for the maximum value plus one.

label: psi-output/qualified-scalar-home
entry: A read through a shared scalar element view
claim: The shared loan points to the home initialized from formal zero. Its referent and receiving obligation name Small. Borrowing the unqualified sibling changes the home and drops the domain. Removing the receiving obligation fails the reader.

label: psi-output/suspending-callable-contract
entry: A suspending runtime callable keeps its selected descriptor
claim: The keep machine retains the exact suspension ceiling of its parameter. Its otherwise identical control carries a non-suspending contract.

label: psi-output/suspending-callable-crossings
entry: A suspending runtime callable keeps its selected descriptor
claim: A reader reconstructs the two different descriptor crossings, acknowledgements, sites and continuation roles. The later descriptor is live across the first call. The plain control has no crossings.

label: psi-output/closed-callback-guarantees
entry: A closed static callback keeps the guarantees of its selected bound
claim: The selected binder promises equality even when its target supplies no guarantee. Adding the target guarantee keeps the wrapper promise unchanged.

label: psi-output/callback-predicate-premises
entry: A callback application inside a predicate retains its bound premises
claim: The application owes the selected binder premise for formal zero. The premise-free control owes none, and strengthening the selected witness alone leaves the application debt unchanged.

label: psi-output/record-domain-formal
entry: A record formal retains its qualified nominal carrier
claim: The entry place resolves to R and R::Live. The control carries R without domains, while the same-shaped S twin names S::Live.

label: psi-output/intact-sum-selected-return-cleanup
entry: Matched sum payloads retain
claim: The tag selects the A edge with a release call or the B edge with a discard. Both edges discard the preceding field before retiring the same home. Swapping their schedules fails the independent reader.

label: psi-output/template-borrow-order
entry: An earlier borrow argument remains active
claim: In the open template of the plan made reusable by a static integer binder, the direct nested helper reads the same formal while the outer call loan is live across steps zero and one. Hoisting the helper before the outer call starts the loan at step one. Both loans retain the selected site and access.

label: psi-output/record-domain-cleanup
entry: A record domain can select cleanup for a qualified owner
claim: The domain selects end. Bare R invokes nothing, qualified R invokes end on its whole place, and selecting finish instead changes both the declaration and returned cleanup target.

label: psi-output/template-affine-field-transfer
entry: An open callback wrapper publishes its binder contract
claim: The selected call takes Audio::tag once. The reader derives the remaining siblings from the schema, observes their reverse declaration order, and rejects removal of the required residual.

label: psi-output/erased-arithmetic-subject
entry: An erased theorem subject can retain computed integer arithmetic
claim: The theorem argument, machine premise and proof let preserve u8 addition and its result-fit obligation. The reader evaluates one plus one to two. Maximum plus one is undefined for exact arithmetic and zero for the wrapping twin.

label: psi-output/nested-theorem-application
entry: A theorem proof can apply another theorem
claim: The reader follows the cited theorem, its requirements, selected hypothesis evidence and guarantee. Changing the witness and erased actual changes the corresponding subjects while preserving their order.

label: psi-output/selected-record-predicate-operator
entry: A user-declared operator in a contract predicate selects its ordinary machine
claim: The predicate names before on T formals zero and one and has no preconditions. The alternate names after on formals one and zero, retains one precondition, and resolves to a different body result.

label: psi-output/selector-disposal-site
entry: An exclusive nominal-element view retains
claim: On the same two assignments the equality premise selects displacement at the second store and the inequality premise selects it at the first. Each schedule discards exactly the displaced cell.

label: psi-output/write-only-affine-replacement
entry: A `@write T` formal keeps write-only access
claim: The selected write-only path retains the affine no-code authority, exact displaced destination and incoming value. The reader rejects a missing or substituted authority.

label: psi-output/write-only-descriptor-replacement
entry: A `@write T` formal keeps write-only access
claim: Even a copyable sum can hold a resident reference. The operation keeps the incoming descriptor origin and resident place for checking without reading the resident tag.

label: psi-output/float-arithmetic-predicate
entry: Float arithmetic and negation inside a contract predicate
claim: The Psi-only reader distinguishes nearest-even addition from exact addition at a binary32 tie and unordered negation on NaN. Both clauses name the operation and format and leave the executable body empty.

label: psi-output/guarded-selector-disposal
entry: An indexed replacement followed immediately
claim: Both indexed stores execute in source order. Walking each selected path finds the exact original contents, moved replacement, cleanup target and occupied store, for both the original and bounded nominal-cleanup programs.

label: psi-output/immutable-record-sequence
entry: A `[T]` held by value is an immutable sequence
claim: The Psi reader follows the stored-length result to the exact Route elements. The empty roster and the ordered values 4 and 9 retain the same element type.

label: psi-output/imported-data-predicate
entry: A package that stores toolchain data publishes
claim: BoundaryReach retains the defining toolchain schema, including its service_count predicate. The consumer reads the same declared field under its toolchain identity.

label: psi-output/executed-unrestricted-domain
entry: For `domain i32::Locked access Rule`
claim: the domain named by the prepared policy obligation carries unrestricted issuance from the executed return

label: psi-output/executed-empty-domain
entry: For `domain i32::Locked access Rule`
claim: the captured domain carries an empty issuer set from its selected policy

label: psi-output/closed-policy-constructor
entry: `lower_selected_policy_unit` assembles the closed body
claim: the executable call names the toolchain constructor body in the selected unit

label: psi-output/imported-operation-sites
entry: A closed body that calls an imported machine with a body
claim: the constructor in the linked closure retains its defining declaration and the original site of every operation

label: psi-output/applied-caller-region
entry: A call of a machine with region binders
claim: the selected callee region and the correct caller binder remain attached to this exact call, including a caller with two binders

label: psi-output/rebuilt-stored-view
entry: A machine with only region binders
claim: forward rebuilt from schema.storage keeps one body and the forwarded twin's region slots; the field of the returned establishment is a copy of the descriptor stored in the formal's storage field, which the record's row places at binder zero

label: psi-output/operand-carried-call-region
entry: A call of a machine with region binders
claim: start declares no region binder, so the row for size(held) leaves size's region to the call's operands; the Psi-only reader follows operand zero to the record's establishment and from the field stored at its lifetime to start's own formal bytes

label: psi-output/inherited-predicate-completion
entry: A predicate-bearing scalar cast
claim: the cast retains the exact parent on the source, adds only the child and attaches its predicate obligation to the fresh destination on the same jump

label: psi-output/inherited-tag-completion
entry: A predicate-bearing scalar cast
claim: the separate predicate domain, parent and child all gain their own origins on one jump; the predicate domain supplies the only predicate obligation
